items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: She died a year I was born.

ctx.x: The names of the family. The names of the family. I think we got it all right. About your mother, uh, Louise Monette. Mm-hmm. And married L-A-M-O-N-T-H-E. L-A. The little L-A. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .
She died a year I was born.
Those days they didn't have birth certificates, I guess, hardly. No, I got... Death certificates even, so they didn't keep those records.
